title: The Parlour
venue_description:
The Parlour - Providence's Award-Winning Music Venue

Popular North Main Street spot known for its strong live music programming and supportive open mic nights.

Live Music and Events

Weekly open mics (Tuesdays) welcoming musicians, poets, comedians, and more. Additional jams and shows throughout the week.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Intimate setting with full bar, great sound, and a passionate music-loving crowd.
